description: Wrong comparison operator — uses < instead of <=
buggy_code:
def is_passing(score):
    """Return True if score is 60 or above."""
    return score > 60

# Test cases
print(is_passing(60))   # Expected: True, Got: False
print(is_passing(61))   # Expected: True, Got: True
print(is_passing(59))   # Expected: False, Got: False
traceback:
No exception raised.
Expected: is_passing(60) should return True
Actual: is_passing(60) returns False
The boundary value 60 is not handled correctly.

ground_truth.root_cause: Uses 'score > 60' (strictly greater) but should be 'score >= 60' to include the boundary value 60
